'''Zureber syrup''' was a blue drink, presumably made from [[zureber bush]]es. On a trip to [[Susevfi]] to rescue [[Mirax Terrik Horn]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] enjoyed this drink during the flight.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>{{Food-stub}}
